## Summary

Describe the change and the user or developer problem it solves.

## Validation

List automated tests, manual checks, and hardware used. State what could not be
tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass and changed behavior has coverage.
- [ ] Display-policy changes fail closed and restore the previous layout.
- [ ] No private host data, credentials, SDK files, or SDK-linked binaries are included.
- [ ] Contributions are submitted under `MIT OR Apache-2.0`.
